detail.longDescription:
Meet the My Verizon app. It’s everything Verizon, all in one place. Launch the app and get your latest personalized view of customizable shortcuts, your current balance, bill savings, perks, offers and more. And to find what you’re looking for faster, switch between different app sections using the tab bar. 

What’s inside:
There’s loyalty you’ll love, featuring Verizon Shine for daily drops, epic experiences and more. Plus, opt in to start scoring 3% cash back every single month with Verizon Dollars. 

Your Mobile and Home Internet accounts are just a tap away. Quickly manage your devices, make plan changes, view usage and discover everything your plan has to offer. Keep track of all your Home Internet accounts, 5G Home. LTE Home and Fios. 

With our simplified bill, you can see details, schedule AutoPay and make secure payments. 

Best of all, you can shop or upgrade right from the app. It’s the fastest way to get what you want for Mobile and Home. 

Looking for answers? Support’ has you covered. Chat with your Verizon Assistant 24/7, walk through account details, explore new plans, get help with troubleshooting and more. 

Everything is easier with the MyVerizon app. Do it all. All in one place.
